```{r}

ds <- read.csv("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/data/2021/2021_csv/fhvhv_tripdata_2021-12.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",")


library(dplyr)

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

hourly_check <- ds %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract hour directly from the timestamp to avoid 'closure' errors
    hour_numeric = hour(pickup_datetime),
    tip_ratio_calc = tips / base_passenger_fare
  ) %>%
  group_by(hour_numeric) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_tip_dollars = mean(tips, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_fare_dollars = mean(base_passenger_fare, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_ratio = mean(tip_ratio_calc, na.rm = TRUE),
    sample_size = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(hour_numeric)

print(hourly_check)
hourly_check
print(hourly_check, n = Inf)





library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

ds_tips <- ds %>%
  select(
    # --- The Target Variables ---
    tips, 
    base_passenger_fare,
    
    # --- The Predictors ---Congestion surcharge — massive positive effect
    trip_miles,           # Trip Distance
    trip_time,            # Trip Duration
    pickup_datetime,      # To derive "Time Period"
    shared_request_flag,  # Shared status
    shared_match_flag     # Whether the share actually happened
  ) %>%
  # Filter out fares of 0 or less to allow for tip ratio calculation
  filter(base_passenger_fare > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create the dependent variable
    tip_ratio = tips / base_passenger_fare,
    
    # Extract the time period (e.g., Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Night)
    hour = hour(pickup_datetime),
    time_period = case_when(
      hour >= 5 & hour < 11  ~ "Morning Rush",
      hour >= 11 & hour < 16 ~ "Midday",
      hour >= 16 & hour < 20 ~ "Evening Rush",
      TRUE                   ~ "Late Night"
    ),
    # Convert flags to factors for modeling
    shared_request_flag = as.factor(shared_request_flag)
  )
```


```{r}
# Step 1: Calculate the means
interaction_data <- ds_tips %>%
  group_by(time_period, shared_request_flag) %>%
  summarize(mean_tip = mean(tip_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: Plot
ggplot(interaction_data, aes(x = time_period, y = mean_tip, 
                             color = shared_request_flag, group = shared_request_flag)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Interaction: Shared Status vs. Time Period",
    subtitle = "How sharing a ride affects tipping behavior across the day",
    x = "Time Period",
    y = "Average Tip Ratio",
    color = "Shared Request?"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
